questions.prompt: What is the big idea of Fruits?
choices: A flower can grow into a fruit.
Only grapes grow together in bunches.
questions.answer: A flower can grow into a fruit.
questions.rationale: Bite an apple. It feels crisp. Grapes grow together in bunches. Fruits come in many colors, shapes, and sizes. Together, these facts show the whole-book big idea: A flower can grow into a fruit.
